answer: For 2025 Sanofi reported 100% own-workforce health-and-safety-system coverage; zero own-workforce injury/ill-health fatalities; zero other-worker site fatalities from work-related injuries; 182 recordable own-workforce accidents; a 1.4 recordable-accident rate; 30 recordable employee ill-health cases; a 0.9 lost-time injury frequency rate; and zero serious injuries and fatalities. TRI and LTI rates are per million hours over a rolling 12-month period. LTI and serious-injury indicators are voluntary; unavailable December 2025 hours were replaced with November hours. Commutes are excluded for fixed-location workers but included for travelling medical representatives, and telework accidents have been included since 2021.

normalized_value.voluntary_metrics: lost-time injury frequency rate and number of serious injuries and fatalities
normalized_value.boundary_and_estimate: fixed-location commuting accidents excluded; travelling-medical-representative commuting and telework accidents included; November hours rolled into unavailable December 2025 hours
